_comment: Target WhatsApp groups for the daily Genaie-services ad. Use group JIDs (ending in @g.us); the bot must be a MEMBER of each. Invite links are NOT reliably resolvable on this gateway (WhatsApp channels resolve is unsupported and the directory is config-backed), so always list JIDs here. This aims to cover every group the bot is in EXCEPT 'Vacancy Lamp' (120363407177302513@g.us), which is deliberately omitted. Named groups for reference: Bindura Town Business, Shamva Bindura & Madziva, Bindura Hustlers 24/7, Glendale Hustlers 24/7 (others have no cached subject). NOTE: membership cannot be listed via the gateway, so groups are discovered from the WhatsApp sender-key store (credentials/whatsapp/default/sender-key-<jid>...). The last two JIDs below were silently-joined groups (relevance-gated, no agent session) found on 2026-08-30 that were missing from the ad; discover newly-joined groups the same way. Admin-only groups the bot cannot post to (send returns 'forbidden') are omitted. Edit this list to add/remove groups; no code change needed. Newly-joined groups for reference: Buying and Selling (120363292471414376@g.us), Zim Mining Company (120363411788614990@g.us), TerraTones Advertising (120363374641440124@g.us). Admin-only (announcement) group 120363157571427036@g.us is omitted: the bot cannot post there (send returns 'forbidden'). Newly-joined groups added 2026-10-11 (discovered via the WhatsApp sender-key store; names TBD): 120363410412233096, 120363426951301193, 120363414718035443, 120363217323303430, 120363426924923592. Removed 2026-10-12 after their first full day of sends failed: 120363406180229523, 120363427198843381, 120363406036971278 and 120363427762371217 return 'forbidden' (admin-only, or the bot is no longer a member) and 120363427719606842 returns 'item-not-found' (group gone or bot removed). The sender-key store keeps keys for groups the bot has left, so a key there does not prove current membership.
